integrity_notes: Proof is a characteristic-p cyclic descent and finite-group trace calculation. Exhaustive checks cover only the four stated finite fields and are not the infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem applies to the one-rational-point family outside the indicated degree-two subfield, not arbitrary Hermitian-relative curves. Full comparison with a separate 2026 projective-classification chapter was not possible. General Hermitian maximality and root-of-unity arguments are prior knowledge; no independent audit was performed.
title: Exact zeta function of the one-rational-point Hermitian relatives
